claim: Heterogeneous change amplification is better modeled as typed M_delta than one scalar R_delta when propagation types differ.
A hierarchical causal governor may outperform flat vector control under coupled nonstationary constraints, but switching cost is a required shadow.
Coordination closure should be pair/path-sensitive over asymmetric dependencies and invariants rather than only operation classes.
Multi-resolution summary-plus-zoom memory and recurrence-aware retention are plausible alternatives to binary retain/evict.
Root-bound Gamma should invalidate masks by semantic dependency deltas rather than rebuild every mask on every root change.
Workspace evidence should be an intervention-weighted metric vector rather than one ignition/reportability scalar.
Materialized arrangements should be selected adaptively from reuse versus update/storage/rebuild economics.
Edge backend selection should be contextual and online rather than universal across device/regime states.
